analysis_resolution.downsampling: aspect-preserving OpenCV INTER_AREA; alpha mask uses nearest-neighbor
analysis_resolution.raw_source: raw files are hash-verified and never modified; features use only the analysis raster

color_proportion_definition.denominator: pixels within an accepted heuristic fruit mask and visible alpha region
color_proportion_definition.hue_units: degrees [0,360); ranges are half-open; hue outside named ranges is not counted

feature_origin.original_color: HSV/CIELAB pixel statistics within accepted Phase 2 heuristic fruit mask on original RGB
feature_origin.gray_world_color: same statistics after Phase 1 Gray World using its corresponding Phase 2 heuristic fruit mask
feature_origin.original_lab_k3: Phase 3 K-Means Lab K=3 on original RGB and accepted heuristic fruit mask
feature_origin.original_hsv_k5: Phase 3 K-Means HSV K=5 on original RGB and accepted heuristic fruit mask
feature_origin.gray_world_lab_k3: comparative Gray World K-Means Lab K=3 features
feature_origin.gray_world_hsv_k5: comparative Gray World K-Means HSV K=5 features

missing_values: Blank CSV cells mean unavailable; no imputation is performed. If a valid K-Means run has no selected cluster, detection/area are 0 while suspicious-region color moments remain blank.
leakage_controls: labels, splits, ground-truth masks, and source metadata are never passed to feature functions
ripeness and defect tables are built from the saved Phase 0.2 split CSVs without modifying them
defect K-Means branches share one row/image_id and do not multiply training sample count
